result:
I've fixed both round-2 register findings. I re-ran every check on the final tree after the outage and all of them pass: the merge script, `check_counts.py`, `validate.mjs --register DG0`, both new checkers, and the 37 gate and guard tests. Both findings stay OPEN until a reviewer other than me verifies them.

**F-DG0-006 (source labelling of PB rows)**
- **REQ-PB-088:** now cites M0348, and the M0348 coverage row lists it.
- **REQ-PB-068:** the M0212 publication block is now listed under "Master-prompt additions" instead of "Interpretations".
- **Re-scan of all 93 PB rows:** I wrote `docs/analysis/tools/check_pb_provenance.py` to compare each row's notes with its `source_ref`. On the old register it found 115 problems of the same kind as the finding.
  - **Anchors named but not cited:** the new `parts/ref-additions-an08.csv` adds 59 anchors to 46 rows, and each is also added to its coverage row. I read each anchor's text before adding it.
  - **Section-only citations:** notes that named only a section now name a specific anchor.
  - **Wrongly labelled items:** six rows had text the master prompt states filed as interpretation; they are now additions (PB-003, -007, -031, -063, -068, -082). Seven rows cited the master prompt for what is really my own reading; I removed those citations (PB-006, -008, -011, -035, -036, -061, -073).
  - **What didn't change:** no row's scope, class, stage, gate or status.
- **Exception:** REQ-PB-049 still names M0406 without citing it. It is only there to justify the DG3 gate assignment, and the checker allows it explicitly.
- **Needs a reviewer's judgement:** the checker can only enforce consistency. Whether each item counts as an addition or an interpretation was my call per row, so a domain reviewer should spot-check those rows.

**F-DG0-207 (tests cited in acceptance text)**
- **REQ-DLV-013 and REQ-DLV-026:** now cite the real test, 'A24 / F-DG0-102: fabricated or incomplete provenance is rejected'.
- **Other stale references:** `docs/analysis/tools/check_test_refs.py` found them in 8 more rows, and I fixed those too (REQ-DLV-005, -007, -016, -017, -022, -023, -032, -040). They had shortened or unprefixed titles, or descriptions like "guard tests pass" with no title.
- **Result:** all 19 quoted test titles now match the titles in the test files exactly. Those 37 titles are the same as the list in your assignment, and the checker also checks that.

**Gap:** REQ-DLV-020's acceptance says the validator rejects a row with an empty required column, an invalid class, or a SOURCE row with no playbook block. The validator has that logic, but no test covers those three cases. The acceptance text doesn't name a test, so I left it alone. A reviewer should check it directly, or whoever owns `tools/gates` should add a test; I can't write there.

The handback, with the full check outputs, is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG0/T-DG0-AN-08-transformation-analyst.md`.
